traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Additional Information: Russula roseipes is characterized by its reddish to pinkish-brown cap and white to cream-colored gills. It is found in both broadleaf and coniferous forests, especially in association with pines and spruces. Its mild odor and closely spaced, adnate gills are distinguishing features. The edibility is not well-documented, making it advisable to exercise caution.
